message.content:
Source looks correct. Let me add a few more boundary tests, then run everything and update HANDOFF.md.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat >> tests/test_tagged.py << 'EOF'


class TestBoundaryExtras:
    def test_resize_shrink_from_full_capacity(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1, ['ta'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['tb'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['tc'])
        c.resize(1)
        assert c.maxsize == 1
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('c') == 3  # MRU survives
        assert c.invalidate('ta') == 0
        assert c.invalidate('tb') == 0
        assert c.invalidate('tc') == 1

    def test_resize_empty_cache(self):
        c = TaggedCache(4)
        c.resize(1)
        assert c.maxsize == 1
        assert len(c) == 0
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.put('b', 2)
        assert 'a' not in c and c.get('b') == 2

    def test_invalidate_many_generator_raises_on_second_pass(self):
        state = {'n': 0}

        def gen():
            for t in ['x', 'y']:
                state['n'] += 1
                yield t

        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        c.invalidate_many(gen(), mode='any')
        assert state['n'] == 2  # exactly one pass, no re-iteration
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_invalidate_many_all_empty_on_populated_cache(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x'])
        # empty requested tags must NOT match every key (superseded note)
        assert c.invalidate_many([], mode='all') == 0
        assert c.invalidate_many([], mode='any') == 0
        assert len(c) == 2

    def test_invalidate_many_all_single_tag(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x'], mode='all') == 2
        assert len(c) == 0

    def test_resize_failed_then_successful(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.put('b', 2)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.resize(True)
        c.resize(1)
        assert c.maxsize == 1
        assert len(c) == 1

    def test_put_after_resize_shrink_no_stale_tags(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['x'])
        c.resize(1)  # evicts a, b; c survives
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 1  # only 'c'
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 0
        # reuse evicted key with different tags
        c.put('a', 4, ['z'])
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 0
        assert len(c) == 1
EOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
